basic_info.name: Beyond Snack
basic_info.description: Beyond Snack was born in Kerala, the home of India's most loved banana chips - and built on a simple belief: that the everyday banana chip deserved to be made better than anyone had ever made it.We start with authentic Nendran bananas sourced directly from our farmers, and craft every chip in a women-led facility using a refined, hands-free process built for purity and consistency. The result is the crunch, freshness, and quality that has made us the most loved Indian banana chips brand - and a brand people reach for again and again.We're proud of where we come from and the hands that make us. As we grow, our mission stays the same: to become the most loved snack brand in the world, one honest, delicious bite at a time.
